problemStatement.formal: \text{Construct a random object, then deterministically remove violations.}
problemStatement.plain: The alteration (deletion) method improves on pure expectation arguments: instead of hoping a random object is already good, we start with a random object and then fix it by removing problematic parts. If few parts are problematic in expectation, the remaining object is still large/useful.

currentState.focus: Formalize the alteration/deletion method. Depends on prob-method-expectation.
